async-ready-browser.scope: Read-only real plugin data; await Steam all five loading flags and Douban loading completion before capture. No configuration changes.

runtimeFixtureCorrection.earlierClasspath: Cached Spring 6.2.9 / Jackson 2.19.2; historical fixture result retained.
runtimeFixtureCorrection.verifiedClasspath: Read-only copies from Halo runtime: Spring 7.0.10 / Jackson 2.21.7 / Thymeleaf 3.1.3.RELEASE / JsonPropertyAccessor 7.1.2.
runtimeFixtureCorrection.scope: Actual runtime libraries with isolated data, not a complete Halo boot or modified site settings.

method.source: Docker container halo stdout/stderr via docker logs --timestamps
method.time_filter: Docker timestamp with nanosecond precision; event headers determine event window; physical lines additionally counted by their Docker timestamps.
limitations: Container stdout/stderr is not independently verified complete HTTP access logging.
An available retained line older than the window does not prove an application emitted every relevant event or that no events were lost.
Generic logs do not distinguish active theme from preview theme or correlate an event to an individual browser or HTTP request.
This is a snapshot ending at the stated cutoff; later events are excluded.

alist_attachment_reconciler_excluded.evidence: AttachmentReconciler, AList DTO and Jackson MismatchedInputException occur in the same error blocks; the blocks describe an array where an integer was expected and re-enqueue.
alist_attachment_reconciler_excluded.scope: AList is excluded by the user. Logs do not prove the same attachment or successful retry.

page_size_limit.summary: Halo reset requested page size to its 1000 limit.
page_size_limit.scope: Equipment 1.1.1 has a previously identified plugin-side oversized pagination behavior; these generic entries have no request ID or stack and cannot individually be attributed to Equipment.

template_interrupted.summary: Runtime bytecode shows these messages are emitted by an Exception-class doOnError callback, conditional on particular underlying exception types; they are not direct doOnCancel log entries.
template_interrupted.limitation: The log records no request ID, stack or HTTP status. Bytecode establishes the tested exception conditions, but not who interrupted or cancelled anything, why it happened, which request it was, whether a cancellation happened, or whether this is a theme regression.

runtime_bytecode_evidence.method: Read-only javap -p -c of the running container application jar and runtime dependencies; no induced cancellation or browser operation.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.call_path: HaloTemplateEngine.processStream calls SpringWebFluxTemplateEngine.processStream. For its Mono or Flux result it applies subscribeOn and doOnError(Exception.class, callback); both callbacks invoke logTemplateError. No doOnCancel call is present in the inspected HaloTemplateEngine class.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.reactor_unwrap: The inspected reactor-core 3.8.8 Exceptions.unwrap repeatedly unwraps Exceptions.ReactiveException cause links and returns the resulting throwable.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.limit: These class-file conditions do not establish a direct cancellation signal, the initiator, the reason, or the request. An interruption exception can arise without proving subscriber cancellation.

time_overlap.context: The parent reports a history fault-injection operation during this interval. The timestamps coincide; no request-level or causal link has been established.

http_client_read_timeout.summary: An outbound HTTP client connection observed a read timeout.
http_client_read_timeout.limitation: The destination is deliberately redacted; this warning does not identify the triggering request, page, feature, underlying cause or theme. It is not proof of a theme HTTP 500.

rss_refresh.summary: No RSS service warning/error was logged in this window; that does not prove the earlier RSS issue was resolved.

earlier_sample_outside_this_window.limitation: The 500 source and underlying cause were not established; an upstream HTTP 500 versus a plugin-side generated response cannot be determined.

cross_check_notes: Parent reported HTTP, plugin, browser and template-fixture verification separately; these results do not identify the request or cause of a particular warning.
Zero selected marker matches cannot prove no HTTP 500, uncaptured template error or external network failure.
No raw log, complete external URL, network address, credential, cookie or map coordinate is included.

selectedAssetComparison.scope: Only these 14 selected served assets compared. Does not establish whole-source tree identity or rerun historical business interactions.

navigationHeaderRegression.scope: Only visitor menu header and its actual Thymeleaf/Spring integration regression; no project build, browser, configuration or Git operation.

green.runtime: Spring 7.0.10, actual archived Halo dependency classpath; Map and Jackson with JsonPropertyAccessor

limits: Header rendering replaces only contributor lookup with fixture user; LinkBuilder returns base paths in a non-web Context.
No actual authenticated session, site configuration change, browser or full build.
Historical fixture-stage pending step: final rebuilding, served resources, cache and browser screenshot were pending when this fixture ran. They were completed later; see finalAcceptanceFollowup.
navigationHeaderRegression.recordedStage: Historical fixture-only record, produced before final build and browser checks; original fixture file preserved.

finalAcceptanceFollowup.status: Final build, cache refresh, 14 served-asset hashes and 390px anonymous mobile-menu checks subsequently passed.
finalAcceptanceFollowup.remainingLimits: The fixture itself did not start a complete Halo application or use a real authenticated session; final mobile-menu browser evidence covers the existing anonymous configuration only.

window_utc.bounds: inclusive; exact nanosecond comparison of Docker timestamps

method.source: docker logs --timestamps for the existing local halo container; one second before start to two seconds after cutoff fetched, then exact in-memory window filtering
method.classification_unit: A structured severity-bearing header plus following continuation/stack lines is one event; stack lines are not additional errors.
method.redaction: Raw logs are read in memory only and not saved or printed. No credentials, tokens, Cookie, complete third-party URLs, remote addresses, map URLs or coordinates are included.
coverage_limitations: The generic container log does not identify active versus preview theme for each event.
This is not a complete HTTP access log. Zero marker matches or a quiet final interval do not prove zero requests or zero HTTP errors.
The earlier readable log coverage was checked to predate this window; rotating json-file logs may still limit historical evidence. No earlier events are included in the counts.

alist_attachment_reconciler_excluded.summary: 四条控制器错误事件的堆栈包含 AttachmentReconciler、AList 和 MismatchedInputException，指向 JSON 数组转 int 的类型不匹配。
alist_attachment_reconciler_excluded.limitation: 按用户要求独立记录并排除。未证明后续重试成功，也未证明四条是否对应同一附件；不据此判定主题回归。

page_size_limit.summary: 请求页大小超过 Halo 1000 上限，被重置为 1000。
page_size_limit.limitation: 既有 Equipment 1.1.1 插件曾确认存在过大分页请求，属于相关插件范围背景；当前通用日志条目无请求 ID 或堆栈，无法将这 12 条逐条归因于 Equipment、主题或具体页面。

template_interrupted.summary: 三条日志均为 Interrupted while processing template: author；未附堆栈或请求 ID。
template_interrupted.limitation: 运行字节码可确定该消息由处理异常的分支记录；不能据此确认订阅取消信号、谁取消、为何中断或具体请求。与浏览器动作或窗口重合仅是时序事实，原因未定位。

runtime_bytecode_evidence.method: Read-only javap -p -c of the running container application jar and runtime dependencies; no induced cancellation or browser operation.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.call_path: HaloTemplateEngine.processStream calls SpringWebFluxTemplateEngine.processStream. For its Mono or Flux result it applies subscribeOn and doOnError(Exception.class, callback); both callbacks invoke logTemplateError. No doOnCancel call is present in the inspected HaloTemplateEngine class.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.reactor_unwrap: The inspected reactor-core 3.8.8 Exceptions.unwrap repeatedly unwraps Exceptions.ReactiveException cause links and returns the resulting throwable.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.limit: These class-file conditions do not establish a direct cancellation signal, the initiator, the reason, or the request. An interruption exception can arise without proving subscriber cancellation.
runtime_bytecode_evidence.reuse_validation: This sampling rechecked the running application jar SHA-256; it matches the application jar inspected for the prior bytecode evidence. Historical observed counts have been removed.

http_client_read_timeout.summary: 两条 HttpClientConnect 事件出现 io.netty.handler.timeout.ReadTimeoutException。
http_client_read_timeout.limitation: 不输出远端地址；缺少请求级关联，不能确定对应哪个页面、第三方服务或用户操作，也不能据此归因主题。

rss_refresh.summary: 本窗口未命中 RssService 或 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR 选定标记。
rss_refresh.limitation: 该窗口的零命中不能证明历史 RSS 刷新 500 已修复、来源已定位，或全站没有 HTTP 500；历史问题仍为来源未定位。

other_warning_or_error.summary: 匹配到的结构化事件头中，没有上述分类以外的 WARN/ERROR/FATAL。
other_warning_or_error.limitation: 受限于指定容器、可读日志、窗口与匹配格式，不能替代完整 HTTP 访问日志。

cross_check_notes: Independent checks bind this report to the recorded fingerprint, matching browser-report fingerprints, unchanged key source hashes, 14 matching asset records and the unchanged running application-jar hash; the aggregate project fingerprint is read from the environment rather than recomputed here.

The main agent reports 273 regressions with no skips, HTTP 114/114, plugins 33/33, 14 resource matches and 64 first-screen groups. Those totals are not re-executed by this read-only reviewer and do not explain any individual warning.
Publishing/uploading browser states use fetch substitutes in isolated owner DOM. Counter mock twice and Passkey options blocked six times do not establish real business submission or authentication.
No container/project/plugin/database/business configuration was modified; no logs were cleared, no browser was operated and no cancellation request was induced.

independentReview.scope: Code review and selected source images reviewed separately from implementer verification. No claim of all UI journeys or real business writes.

remaining.item: Equipment 1.1.1 pagination limit and >1000 data completeness; server-side comment subject provider
remaining.action: No plugin edits; theme cannot fully fix server contract.
No infrastructure or business configuration changes.

remaining.item: Valid remote map key, real Docsme languages, external SSO, real illustration/bottom Dock/custom route or disabled-comment site configuration, actual protected RSS state writes, real publish/registration/reset/comment/form/vote/raffle submissions
remaining.action: Fixtures and read-only page passes do not certify these business chains.

remaining.item: AI and Passkey previously reported passed by user
remaining.action: Retain provenance; not relabeled as current automated E2E.

remaining.item: AList excluded; Friends retired into Links; disabled/admin-only plugins not certified by theme page checks
Final sampled window includes 3 author template interruption warnings and 2 outbound HTTP read timeout warnings.
remaining.action: No confirmed theme cause or request-level correlation; retain as unresolved instead of suppressing logs or modifying plugins.

toolingCorrections.item: Browser helper focus can reset emulated mobile viewport; CDP Enter without character default action did not activate native button; drawer animation must settle.
toolingCorrections.resolution: Final menu test uses DOM focus, real keyboard/point inputs, settled drawer and asserts actual 390px throughout; earlier failed tools runs retained in local temp.

toolingCorrections.resolution: Original core-browser-v3 log retained; current state inspected and core-browser-v4 waits for completed navigation before asserting.

toolingCorrections.resolution: All task-owned supplemental contexts closed; source and served asset identity verified.

toolingCorrections.item: First menu supplemental script waited for a scroll-driven finite-iteration animation, which does not finish at a fixed wall-clock time; tool timed out at 300 seconds.
toolingCorrections.resolution: Failed run retained; task context closed; re-run only settles DocumentTimeline animations with a bound, then checks pointer, Enter/Escape, focus and actual 390px viewport.

toolingCorrections.resolution: Original failure retained. Official deployed halo-tracker.js consumes response text; browser substitutes 200 text 0 for this counter only. All 64 records re-run. This does not validate counting.

toolingCorrections.item: A partial six-file baseline reconstruction did not reproduce the complete earlier source digest.
toolingCorrections.resolution: No whole-source unchanged claim is made. Only 13/14 selected asset hashes are proved equal; historical specialty tests retain their original digest.

toolingCorrections.item: The visit-counter substitute used during the 64-record scan was missing from archived runner scripts.
toolingCorrections.resolution: Original records and scripts preserved. Corrected supplemental runner archived with source hashes; /privacy at 1440 and 390 passed with one text counter substitute each. These two later checks do not replace or increase the original 64-record count and are outside the sampled backend-log window.
